note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 21 November 2026, RealHunt lists 62 homes for sale in the United States, each one checked by a person.
In the United States, the median asking price of those 62 homes is €214,900 (€1,570 per m², from the 62 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €65,428 and the most expensive €447,600.
Taxes and fees add about 2–5% to the price of a home in the United States (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Closing costs vary by state and typically run 2-5% of the loan amount, covering title search and title insurance, recording fees, attorney fees, appraisal and lender fees; since August 2024 the seller no longer has to pay the buyer's agent, so the buyer may pay it unless the seller agrees to; FIRPTA does not apply when you buy but does when a foreigner later sells, with the buyer generally withholding 15% of the sale price.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. There is no federal ban on foreigners buying homes, but about 30 states have added some limits, and Texas and Florida restrict buyers from certain countries such as China.
buying.annual_property_tax: Property tax is set locally and in 2024 averaged about 1.22% of value across the largest city in each state, from 0.30% in Honolulu to 3.02% in Detroit.
buying.rental_income_tax: By default a non-resident pays 30% of gross rent (or a lower treaty rate), withheld at source, or can elect to treat the rent as business income and pay graduated rates on net income by filing Form 1040-NR and giving Form W-8ECI to the withholding agent.

homes.title: Updated 3-bed house in Huntington, West Virginia
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios actualizada en Huntington, Virginia Occidental
homes.summary: 150 m² (1,614 sq ft), 3 bed, 2 bath, built 1923. Asking $89,900. The listing mentions: double city lot, new flooring, spacious living room, updated kitchen.

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bed house in Chapmanville, West Virginia
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir en Chapmanville, Virginia Occidental
homes.summary: 176 m² (1,897 sq ft), 2 bed, 1 bath, built 1954. Asking $95,000. The listing mentions: fenced yard, covered porch, concrete bridge access, newer metal roof.

homes.title: Updated 3-bed townhouse in McKees Rocks, Pennsylvania
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 3 dormitorios actualizada en McKees Rocks, Pensilvania
homes.summary: 106 m² (1,140 sq ft), 3 bed, 1.5 bath, built 1909. Asking $75,000. The listing mentions: full brick row home, welcoming front porch, newer laminate flooring, updated double pane windows.

homes.title: Renovated 1889 Victorian with a deep front porch in Lynchburg, Virginia
homes.title_es: Casa victoriana de 1889 renovada con porche delantero profundo en Lynchburg, Virginia
homes.summary: Asking US$245,000 (about €223,300) for a renovated 1889 Victorian of about 289 m² in Lynchburg, a historic city on the James River at the foot of the Blue Ridge. It keeps its high ceilings, tall windows, hardwood floors and ornate carved fireplace mantels, and the white kitchen has stainless appliances. The main bedroom suite and the laundry are on the ground floor. Outside there is a deep covered front porch, a planted front garden and the original carriage house for storage. The metal roof and blue siding look well kept in the photos. Yearly property tax US$1,638, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Updated 2-bed house in Cleveland, Oklahoma
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios actualizada en Cleveland, Oklahoma
homes.summary: 98 m² (1,054 sq ft), 2 bed, 1 bath, built 1916. Asking $79,000. The listing mentions: open floor plan, garden window, custom tile shower.

homes.title: The historic Savage House: a white Victorian with a gingerbread porch
homes.title_es: La histórica Savage House: casa victoriana blanca con porche de encaje
homes.summary: Step into the charm of the historic Savage House, a beautiful 1900 Victorian in Scotland Neck, North Carolina: 2,143 sq ft (199 m²) with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, gingerbread trim, a front porch reached by a brick path, high ceilings and freshly finished interiors with wood floors, on a large shaded lot. Asking $169,900 (about €151,000), about €759/m².

homes.title: Updated 1886 house with a fenced garden and an oversized garage in La Crosse, Wisconsin
homes.title_es: Casa de 1886 actualizada con jardín vallado y garaje de gran tamaño en La Crosse, Wisconsin
homes.summary: Asking US$214,900 (about €195,800) for a three-bedroom house of about 142 m² in La Crosse, a university city on the Mississippi in western Wisconsin. Built in 1886, it has had recent updates: fresh paint in many rooms, new central air conditioning, a new water heater and a new deck. The front opens into a bright enclosed porch room, and the galley kitchen has wood-look floors and plenty of cupboards. The fully fenced back garden is neatly landscaped, with a patio and fire pit, and the oversized garage holds three or more cars plus storage. One bathroom. Yearly property tax US$3,565, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Victorian house with original oak woodwork opposite a park in Marietta, Ohio
homes.title_es: Casa victoriana con carpintería de roble original frente a un parque en Marietta, Ohio
homes.summary: Asking US$220,000 (about €200,000) for a 1929 Victorian of about 191 m² in the centre of Marietta, a historic river town in south-east Ohio. The oak staircase, pocket doors, glazed French doors and wide trim are all still in place. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms (one on the ground floor), an eat-in kitchen, a separate dining room, ground-floor laundry and a floored walk-up attic. Outside there is a front porch, rear deck, fenced back garden and a one-car detached garage. A city park, the library and the river trail are across the street or close by. Yearly property tax US$2,127, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Wooded raised ranch with cedar ceilings across the road from Lake Huron, Alpena
homes.title_es: Casa de rancho elevado boscosa con techos de cedro al otro lado de la carretera del Lago Hurón, Alpena
homes.summary: Asking US$250,000 (about €227,700). A 2006 raised ranch of 172 m² on nearly half an acre of woodland, with Lake Huron and a sandy swimming beach just across the road. The open living, dining and kitchen area sits under a cathedral ceiling of white cedar boards, with a wood stove, red oak cabinets and a large kitchen island. There are two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, with room to add a third bedroom. It has in-floor heating, an insulated foundation and a very large heated garage for cars, a boat or a workshop. Property tax US$1,420 a year. HOA US$150 a year for road upkeep and snow clearing.

homes.title: Blue 1907 cottage with 9-foot ceilings and a new kitchen
homes.title_es: Casita azul de 1907 con techos altos y cocina nueva
homes.summary: A 1907 cottage with two bedrooms in about 83 m², freshly painted outside, with 9-foot ceilings, open beams, brand-new flooring and an open kitchen and dining area. Covered porch, private back yard and a detached garage, in Freeport, Illinois. That is about €83,700.

homes.title: Updated 3-bed house in Clairton, Pennsylvania
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios actualizada en Clairton, Pensilvania
homes.summary: 116 m² (1,248 sq ft), 3 bed, 2 bath, built 1938. Asking $98,500. The listing mentions: large deck, spacious updated kitchen, ample closet space, full common bath.

homes.title: Fully restored 1940s cottage with a deep front porch on a corner lot in Hot Springs
homes.title_es: Cabaña completamente restaurada de los años 40 con porche frontal profundo en esquina en Hot Springs
homes.summary: Asking US$199,900 (about €182,100). A 1940 house on a corner lot under tall oak trees, fully restored with all new plumbing and wiring. It keeps its hardwood floors and deep covered front porch, and the living room, dining room and kitchen flow into one another. The kitchen is new, with white cabinets, granite worktops, open shelving and stainless steel appliances. The main bedroom has its own bathroom with a tiled walk-in shower, and there is a second bedroom and a guest bathroom. The back garden is fully fenced and there is a one-car carport. Washer, dryer and fridge are included. Property tax US$820 a year, no HOA.

homes.title: Three-bedroom house with a big fenced yard near the Mississippi in Red Wing
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios con patio grande vallado cerca del Misisipí en Red Wing
homes.summary: Asking US$230,000 (about €209,600) for a 1996 house of about 137 m² on a quiet dead-end street in Red Wing, a historic river town under wooded bluffs on the Mississippi. It has been freshly painted, with hardwood floors on the main level, where the three bedrooms, kitchen and an updated full bathroom are. The finished lower level adds a family room with a gas fireplace and a half bath. Outside there is a deck, a huge fenced back garden, a shed and an attached two-car garage. The aerial photos show the river and Colvill Park close by. Yearly property tax US$2,848, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bed house in McKeesport, Pennsylvania
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir en McKeesport, Pensilvania
homes.summary: 95 m² (1,022 sq ft), 3 bed, 1 bath, built 1901. Asking $95,000. The listing mentions: unique layout, double lot, covered front porch, open loft area.

homes.title: Modern rustic Ozarks cabin minutes from the river
homes.title_es: Cabaña rústica moderna en los Ozarks, a minutos del río
homes.summary: Built in 2008: a two-bedroom cabin of about 104 m² with knotty-pine walls, an open living and dining room and a fitted kitchen, on open land minutes from the North Fork of the White River, Bryant Creek and the Mark Twain National Forest. Full-time home or weekend retreat. That is about €84,500.

homes.title: Updated four-bedroom house with a new kitchen in La Crosse, Wisconsin
homes.title_es: Casa actualizada de cuatro dormitorios con cocina nueva en La Crosse, Wisconsin
homes.summary: Asking US$235,000 (about €214,100) for a house of about 127 m² in La Crosse, a university city on the Mississippi River in western Wisconsin. Built in 1889, it has been updated from top to bottom: a new kitchen with white shaker units, subway tiles and a gas range, stylish new bathrooms including a marble-look shower, light wood-look floors and an open living and dining area. The advert lists four bedrooms. There is a front porch, a fenced side lawn and room behind for a patio or a future garage. Yearly property tax US$2,903, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Renovated four-bedroom house with new roof, kitchen and baths in Sandusky, Lake Erie
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de cuatro dormitorios con tejado, cocina y baños nuevos en Sandusky, Lake Erie
homes.summary: Asking US$236,000 (about €214,900). A 1920 house of 139 m² in the Lake Erie town of Sandusky, redone and ready to move into. The work list includes new siding, windows, roof, gutters, drywall, paint, flooring and lighting, an updated electrical system and partly updated plumbing. The kitchen has new cabinets, granite worktops and new appliances, and both bathrooms are new with glass walk-in showers. There are four bedrooms, one with extra attic storage behind the closet. Outside is a large composite deck, a big back garden and a storage shed. Property tax US$1,128 a year, no HOA.

homes.title: Well-kept 1899 house with a new double garage near Chester Park in Duluth
homes.title_es: Casa de 1899 bien mantenida con garaje doble nuevo cerca de Chester Park en Duluth
homes.summary: Asking US$255,000 (about €232,400) for a house of about 148 m² in Duluth, the hilly port city on Lake Superior. Built in 1899, it has had its furnace, roof, windows, siding, doors, wiring and plumbing all replaced since 2011. Downstairs are spacious living and dining rooms with hardwood floors, a white kitchen with stainless appliances and a door to the back deck, and a half bath with laundry. The three bedrooms and an updated full bathroom are upstairs. There is a newer two-car garage plus an extra parking space, and Chester Park and downtown are close. Yearly property tax US$3,368, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Spacious two-story four-bedroom house with split floor plan in Buffalo Estates, Tampa
homes.title_es: Espaciosa casa de dos pisos con cuatro dormitorios y planta flexible en Buffalo Estates, Tampa
homes.summary: Recently updated with new roof (Jan 2022), fresh exterior and interior paint (May/April 2025), and new carpet (Feb 2026). No flood insurance required and no HOA or CDD fees. Corner lot with flexible split floor plan suited for multi-generational living, with separate entrance potential for guest suite on first floor.

homes.title: Gambrel-roof farmhouse with metal roof and heat pump in Maine
homes.title_es: Casa de granja con tejado holandés, cubierta metálica y bomba de calor en Maine
homes.summary: Three bedrooms and two bathrooms in about 96 m², with hardwood floors, an eat-in kitchen and updated bathrooms. The big jobs are done: metal roof and an efficient heat pump. Green lot in Ashland, in the woods and lakes of northern Maine. That is about €89,000.

homes.title: Garden house with arbor and garage on the Canadian border
homes.title_es: Casa con jardín, pérgola y garaje junto a la frontera de Canadá
homes.summary: A 1943 house with three bedrooms and 1.5 baths in about 124 m². Recent updates: new flooring, new furnace and water heater, new stainless kitchen appliances. Pretty garden with an arbor and a detached garage, near the school and sports fields in Madawaska, Maine, across the river from Canada. That is about €79,300.

homes.title: Riverfront house on French Island with views of the Penobscot
homes.title_es: Casa junto al río en la isla francesa con vistas del Penobscot
homes.summary: A 1,258 sq ft (117 m²) three-bedroom home on historic French Island in Old Town, Maine, with stunning views of the Penobscot River right from the yard: a standing-seam metal roof, a fresh kitchen, a bright living room and a lot that runs down to the water. Bangor and the University of Maine are minutes away. Asking $175,000 (about €159,400), about €1,360/m².

homes.title: Adirondack farmhouse on 10.8 acres of autumn forest
homes.title_es: Casa de campo en los Adirondacks con 4 hectáreas de bosque otoñal
homes.summary: Forestport Adirondack foothills retreat on 10.8 acres: a 1918 farmhouse of 1,577 sq ft (147 m²) with three bedrooms, a renovated grey kitchen with butcher-block counters, a dining room, a living room with a stone accent wall and an enclosed sun porch, surrounded by maple forest that turns red and gold every October. Asking $179,000 (about €159,100), about €1,082/m².

homes.title: Well-kept three-bedroom colonial with a metal roof in Geneva, Finger Lakes
homes.title_es: Colonial de tres dormitorios bien cuidada con tejado de metal en Geneva, Finger Lakes
homes.summary: Asking US$239,900 (about €218,100) for a move-in ready colonial of about 128 m² in Geneva, a small lakeside city in the Finger Lakes region of upstate New York. It has three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, one with a clawfoot tub, plus an enclosed front porch, a large kitchen with a gas range and a generously sized dining area. The furnace, tankless water heater and central air are new, and the vinyl siding and metal roof keep upkeep low. The back garden is private and has a big shed. The photos show a tidy, furnished home. Yearly property tax US$2,919, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Top-floor two-bed condo in a gated resort-style community in Doral
homes.title_es: Condo de dos dormitorios en última planta en comunidad cerrada estilo resort en Doral
homes.place: Las Vistas at Doral, Doral, Miami-Dade County, Florida
homes.summary: An updated 2-bed, 2-bath top-floor condo of 1,197 sq ft in the gated Las Vistas community, with a private balcony, an in-unit washer and dryer and plenty of light. Palm-lined gardens, a large pool and a gym; close to CityPlace Doral, parks, schools and the Palmetto Expressway, about 20 minutes from Miami Airport and Brickell. Asking US$249,000.

homes.title: 1927 brick house with a three-season room and pergola garden in Manitowoc, Wisconsin
homes.title_es: Casa de ladrillo de 1927 con sala de tres estaciones y jardín con pérgola en Manitowoc, Wisconsin
homes.summary: Asking US$249,900 (about €227,700) for a 1927 brick house of about 146 m² on the north side of Manitowoc, a port town on Lake Michigan. It has four bedrooms, two bathrooms, hardwood floors and its original wood trim and doors. A bright three-season room with wood ceiling opens off the front, and an upstairs porch faces the sunsets. The garden is the star: brick paths, tiered beds, raspberry canes and a patio under a grape-covered pergola, plus a detached two-car garage. The photos show a spotless, cared-for home. Yearly property tax US$2,911, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Main house with a second unit in Belmont Heights, Tampa
homes.title_es: Casa principal con una segunda vivienda en Belmont Heights, Tampa
homes.summary: A main house with recent upgrades (2021 roof, 2020 HVAC, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, updated electrical and plumbing) plus a detached one-bedroom apartment with its own living space. Multiple entrances, ample parking and a rear deck. 158 m² and four bedrooms in total, in Belmont Heights, Tampa.

homes.title: Corner three-bed condo with three balconies in Downtown Hollywood
homes.title_es: Condominio de tres dormitorios en esquina con tres balcones en Downtown Hollywood
homes.place: Hollywood Station, Downtown Hollywood, Broward County, Florida
homes.summary: A corner 3-bed, 2-bath condo of 1,522 sq ft in a 2007 building, with three balconies facing the sunsets, two parking spaces, a walk-in closet, washer and dryer, updated floors and a new fridge. The building has a heated pool, hot tub, gym, a 24-hour attended lobby and valet parking. Walk to Hollywood Boulevard, ArtsPark at Young Circle and the shops; the beach is about 2 miles away. Asking US$290,000.

homes.title: Mid-century ranch with open floor plan and mature oaks in Herchel Heights, Tampa
homes.title_es: Rancho de mediados de siglo con planta abierta y robles maduros en Herchel Heights, Tampa
homes.summary: Charming 1958 ranch home with recently renovated interior featuring soaring ceilings, exposed wood ceiling details, and wood-look tile flooring. Open floor plan with seamless indoor-outdoor flow to a fully fenced backyard with patio. Close to parks, the Hillsborough River, and major highways for easy Tampa commuting.

homes.title: Updated first-floor two-bedroom condo near the beach in Maybury Mansions, Fort Lauderdale
homes.title_es: Condo de dos dormitorios en primera planta actualizado cerca de la playa en Maybury Mansions, Fort Lauderdale
homes.summary: Renovated with modern finishes, light-filled spaces, and private outdoor access on the first floor. Located minutes from the beach, downtown Fort Lauderdale, and Las Olas dining. Owner-occupied community with stable occupancy supports conventional financing. Flexible possession available.

homes.title: Fully renovated brick rowhouse with a fenced yard in Lancaster, Pennsylvania
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de ladrillo completamente renovada con patio cercado en Lancaster, Pennsylvania
homes.summary: Asking US$235,000 (about €213,600) for a brick rowhouse of about 127 m² that has been redone from top to bottom. The main floor is open plan with 9-foot ceilings and vinyl plank floors, and the new kitchen has white cabinets, butcher block counters, gas cooking and all appliances. Upstairs are three bedrooms and two new bathrooms with tiled showers, one of them en suite. Gas heating, central air, a usable basement and a fenced back garden complete it. Lancaster is a historic small city in Pennsylvania Dutch country. Yearly property tax US$1,744, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Corner lakefront townhouse with a tropical garden in Westview, Pembroke Pines
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de esquina junto a lago con jardín tropical en Westview, Pembroke Pines
homes.place: Westview, Pembroke Pines, Broward County, Florida
homes.summary: A 2-bed, 1.5-bath corner townhouse of 1,040 sq ft with extra green space, a lush front garden, impact windows throughout, a newer A/C and a covered back porch with direct access to the water. Owner-occupied and well kept, in flood zone X. Clubhouse, fitness center and pool, between Pines Boulevard and Sheridan Street, minutes from I-75 and the Turnpike. Asking US$264,999.

homes.title: Townhouse with a screened patio three blocks from Young Circle, Hollywood
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con patio cerrado a tres manzanas de Young Circle, Hollywood
homes.summary: A 2-bed, 2.5-bath townhouse of 1,300 sq ft with a screened patio, an in-unit washer and dryer, a community pool and one assigned parking space. The HOA covers water and roof repairs. Three blocks from Young Circle and about 3 miles from Hollywood Beach. No leasing allowed, so the neighbours are owners. Asking US$270,000.

homes.title: Renovated house with a two-car garage and a 2024 roof in Greenbriar (55+ community), Boca Raton
homes.title_es: Casa renovada con garaje para dos autos y tejado de 2024 en Greenbriar (comunidad 55+), Boca Raton
homes.place: Boca Chase, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida
homes.summary: 55+ community: at least one resident must be 55 or older. A renovated detached house with 3 bedrooms plus a room that can be a 4th, a two-car garage, a big kitchen open to the dining and family room, a primary suite with walk-in closet and shower, and a screened patio over park-like gardens. Roof and garage door 2024, water heater 2021; the A/C dates from 2014. Walk to the clubhouse, pool, tennis, pickleball and a Publix plaza. The community pool is being repaired. Asking US$435,000 (about €389,800), 1,697 sq ft (158 m²).

homes.title: Gambrel-roof cabin with a wrap porch and fire pit in the Allegheny forest
homes.title_es: Cabaña con tejado de granero, porche y hoguera en el bosque de Allegheny
homes.summary: 'The best cabin weekends start with: who's coming?' A 1986 gambrel-roof cabin on 0.6 acres in Tionesta, on the edge of the Allegheny National Forest: 1,013 sq ft (94 m²) with a wrap-around porch, a knotty-pine kitchen and dining room, a cosy living room with a gas heater, two bedrooms plus a bunk loft, and a fire pit with benches in the yard. Asking $154,900 (about €137,700), about €1,465/m².

homes.title: Scandinavian-style log cabin with a stone fireplace on 10 acres
homes.title_es: Cabaña de troncos estilo escandinavo con chimenea de piedra en 4 hectáreas
homes.summary: A large custom-built Scandinavian-style log cabin from 1998 on a quiet country road in Saxon, Wisconsin, near Lake Superior: 1,430 sq ft (133 m²) with full log walls, a fieldstone hearth with a wood stove, a breakfast bar, three bedrooms, a log staircase to the loft and a green metal roof, on 10 acres of woods. Asking $179,000 (about €159,100), about €1,196/m².

homes.title: Well-kept A-frame on 2.5 acres in Michigan's Upper Peninsula
homes.title_es: Casa A-frame bien cuidada en 2,5 acres en la Península Superior de Michigan
homes.summary: Just outside Kenton, in the Ottawa National Forest area of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, a well-kept 1984 A-frame on 2.49 acres: 1,097 sq ft (102 m²) with three bedrooms, a kitchen with an island, a vaulted wood-panelled loft, a sunroom looking onto the woods, a deck and a fire pit. Snowmobile and ATV trails start nearby. Asking $190,000 (about €173,100), about €1,700/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready three-bedroom house a short walk from downtown Bedford, Virginia
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir a corta distancia del centro de Bedford, Virginia
homes.summary: Asking US$249,996 (about €227,700) for a freshly updated 1960 house of about 109 m² in Bedford, a small town in the foothills of Virginia's Blue Ridge, within a short walk of the shops and restaurants downtown. It has three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, hardwood floors and a bright white kitchen with stainless appliances. The main costly items are recent: the roof was replaced in 2020, the heating and cooling system is four years old and the fridge one. Outside there is a lawn, a covered patio and a second sitting area under a metal canopy, plus a storage shed. Yearly property tax US$1,025, no HOA fee.

homes.title: Bright corner split-level condo with 2.5 baths at Paragon, Plantation
homes.title_es: Condominio luminoso de esquina en dos niveles con 2,5 baños en Paragon, Plantation
homes.place: Paragon at Plantation, Plantation, Broward County, Florida
homes.summary: A corner 2-bed, 2.5-bath condo of 1,316 sq ft laid out on split levels so it feels like a townhouse, with an updated kitchen and bathrooms, modern finishes, light on three sides and a private screened balcony. A well kept 1996 community with a pool and clubhouse, close to shops, restaurants and the main highways. Asking US$280,000.

homes.title: Three-bed lake-view townhouse with a private patio in Miramar
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de tres dormitorios con vistas al lago y patio privado en Miramar
homes.summary: A 3-bed, 2-bath townhouse with panoramic lake views, freshly painted and move-in ready, with central A/C, an in-unit washer and dryer, a fireplace and a private back patio over the water. Two bedrooms are downstairs and one upstairs. Two assigned parking spaces, and a low HOA. Asking US$285,000.

homes.title: Updated corner house with impact windows in Greenbriar at Boca Chase (55+ community)
homes.title_es: Casa en esquina actualizada con ventanas de impacto en Greenbriar at Boca Chase (comunidad 55+)
homes.place: Boca Chase, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida
homes.summary: 55+ community: at least one resident must be 55 or older. A detached 3-bed, 2-bath house on a premium corner lot, with full impact windows and doors, a newer roof, vaulted ceilings, remodeled bathrooms, a granite kitchen, California closets, a screened patio, a fenced garden and a hurricane-rated garage door. The community has pickleball, tennis, a pool, spa and clubhouse, and residents get a Boca Raton beach permit. Asking US$459,999 (about €412,200), 1,580 sq ft (147 m²).

homes.title: Porch cottage on a big lot next to the park in the Ozarks
homes.title_es: Casita con porche y parcela grande junto al parque, en los Ozarks
homes.summary: Two bedrooms and one bath in about 81 m² on a 0.65-acre lot in the middle of Oxford, Arkansas. Move-in ready: new flooring and a new water heater, a covered front porch, a carport and a storage shed. The town park is next door and the shops are a walk away. That is about €88,600.

homes.title: Remodeled lakefront townhouse with impact windows in Pembroke Pines
homes.title_es: Casa adosada frente al lago remodelada con ventanas de impacto en Pembroke Pines
homes.place: Westview, Pembroke Pines, Broward County, Florida
homes.summary: A fully remodeled 2-bed, 2-bath townhouse of 1,040 sq ft with porcelain floors, wood stairs, impact glass windows and sliding doors (better storm protection and lower insurance), a new A/C and washer-dryer from 2021, and a back porch looking straight over the lake. Clubhouse, gym, pool and tennis court; close to Pembroke Lakes Mall. Asking US$245,000.

homes.title: Updated 1,605 sq ft corner flat on Lake Maule with a wraparound balcony
homes.title_es: Piso de esquina actualizado de 1.605 sq ft en Lake Maule con balcón envolvente
homes.summary: A large updated two-bedroom, two-bath corner flat with wood floors, a modern white kitchen with a breakfast bar, a bright living and dining room and two balconies, one wrapping around the living room. It sits on Lake Maule in a building with a marina, pools and tennis, near Aventura Mall and the new Brightline station. Asking US$275,000 (about €246,400), 1,605 sq ft (149 m²).

homes.title: Guard-gated lakeside condo with an oversized balcony at the Atriums, Kendall
homes.title_es: Condominio junto a lago con portería y balcón extra grande en Atriums, Kendall
homes.place: Atriums at Snapper Creek, Kendall, Miami-Dade County, Florida
homes.summary: A 2-bed, 2-bath condo of 1,330 sq ft with a split-bedroom plan, large closets, tile floors, an in-unit washer and dryer, elevator access, extra storage and an oversized private balcony. The guard-gated community sits on a lake among tropical gardens. The monthly fee includes cable TV, high-speed internet, water and building insurance. Asking US$299,000.

homes.title: Renovated 1-bed house in Perryville, Arkansas
homes.title_es: Casa de 1 dormitorio reformada en Perryville, Arkansas
homes.summary: 75 m² (810 sq ft), 1 bed, 1 bath, built 1948. Asking $105,000. The listing mentions: cherry hill area, no restrictions, cleared acreage, open pasture views.

homes.title: Brand-new 2024 log cabin surrounded by farmland in Kentucky
homes.title_es: Cabaña de troncos nueva de 2024 rodeada de campos en Kentucky
homes.summary: A beautiful 2024 log cabin on a 1-acre lot surrounded by farmland in Elk Horn, Kentucky: 1,224 sq ft (114 m²) with a cathedral wood ceiling, a sage-green kitchen with a farmhouse sink and stainless appliances, hardwood floors, two bedrooms, a modern tiled bathroom and a covered front porch. The lot is part of a 29-acre tract. Asking $175,000 (about €155,500), about €1,364/m².

homes.title: High-floor two-bedroom with city views at Commodore Plaza, Aventura
homes.title_es: Apartamento de dos dormitorios en piso alto con vistas a la ciudad en Commodore Plaza, Aventura
homes.summary: A move-in-ready two-bedroom, two-bath flat high up in Commodore Plaza, with a separate living and dining room, a balcony with panoramic city views and a primary suite with a big walk-in closet. The guard-gated building has two pools, a gym, sauna, tennis courts and a marina dock, with cable and water included; Aventura Mall and the Brightline station are close. Asking US$259,000 (about €232,100), 1,073 sq ft (100 m²).

homes.title: Sunset-view two-bedroom at waterfront Commodore Plaza, Aventura
homes.title_es: Apartamento de dos dormitorios con vistas al atardecer en Commodore Plaza, Aventura
homes.summary: A 1,268 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath flat with a separate living room and a private balcony facing the sunset and the city, in Commodore Plaza, a gated waterfront community with a pool by the water, tennis courts and a gym. Minutes from Aventura Mall, restaurants and the beach. Asking US$295,000 (about €264,300), 1,268 sq ft (118 m²).

homes.title: Renovated high-floor two-bedroom with skyline and sunset views in Aventura
homes.title_es: Apartamento renovado de dos dormitorios en planta alta con vistas al horizonte y al atardecer en Aventura
homes.summary: A renovated 1,605 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath flat high up, with skyline and sunset views, a living and dining room and modern finishes, in a building with a private marina, two pools, tennis, a gym, sauna and a courtesy bus around Aventura. It is let until September, so it suits a buyer who does not need to move in before then. Asking US$350,000 (about €313,600), 1,605 sq ft (149 m²).

homes.title: Lakefront three-bedroom house with a screened patio in Country Park, Boca Raton
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios frente al lago con patio cerrado en Country Park, Boca Raton
homes.place: Country Park, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida
homes.summary: A detached 3-bed, 2-bath house on a landscaped lot backing onto the lake, with a family room that opens to a roofed, screened patio over the water, a split-bedroom plan, vaulted ceilings, an eat-in kitchen with newer appliances, impact windows and doors, a circular drive and a fenced garden. The garage was turned into an air-conditioned room and can be turned back. A/C and water heater replaced in 2020. Country Park has a pool, tennis, pickleball and walking trails round five lakes. Asking US$499,500 (about €447,600), 1,610 sq ft (150 m²).

homes.title: Log cabin at Canadohta Lake with a duck pond out front
homes.title_es: Cabaña de troncos en el lago Canadohta con estanque de patos delante
homes.summary: A two-bedroom log cabin at Canadohta Lake in northwest Pennsylvania, with a pond and ducks right in front: about 1,000 sq ft (93 m²) with a wood-panelled living room, a kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances, a loft, a bathroom with laundry, a wrap-around porch, a picnic area and a green metal roof. A short walk to the lake for boating, swimming and ice fishing. Asking $200,000 (about €177,700), about €1,911/m².

homes.title: Waterfront two-bedroom plus den with two balconies at El Prado, Aventura
homes.title_es: Apartamento de dos dormitorios más despacho junto al agua con dos balcones en El Prado, Aventura
homes.summary: A 1,565 sq ft two-bedroom flat with a den that works as an office, an open kitchen, a living room and two balconies, in a full-service waterfront building with two pools, a marina, tennis, a gym and 24-hour gated security. The HOA covers water, Wi-Fi, cable and a repair contract for the air conditioning, plumbing and electrics. Asking US$260,000 (about €233,000), 1,565 sq ft (145 m²).

homes.title: Golf course and skyline views from a two-bedroom at Coronado, Aventura
homes.title_es: Apartamento de dos dormitorios en Coronado, Aventura, con vistas al campo de golf y horizonte
homes.summary: A well-kept 1,138 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath condo on the 23rd floor of Coronado, looking over the golf course and the Aventura skyline, with a living room, covered parking and resort-style amenities with 24-hour security. Move-in ready and a few minutes from Aventura Mall. Asking US$265,000 (about €237,400), 1,138 sq ft (106 m²).

homes.title: Two-bed condo with a split plan over the gardens of Las Vistas, Doral
homes.title_es: Condo de dos dormitorios con planta dividida sobre los jardines de Las Vistas, Doral
homes.place: Las Vistas at Doral, Doral, Miami-Dade County, Florida
homes.summary: A 2-bed, 2-bath condo of 1,036 sq ft with a split floor plan for privacy, a washer and dryer and a balcony over the gardens and pool. One assigned parking space plus a guest space. Residents have a pool, gym and tennis courts, in the heart of Doral near shops, restaurants and the main highways. Asking US$285,000.

homes.title: Corner-lot family house with a big fenced garden of fruit trees, Country Park, Boca Raton
homes.title_es: Casa familiar en lote en esquina con gran jardín cercado de árboles frutales, Country Park, Boca Raton
homes.place: Country Park, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida
homes.summary: A detached 3-bed, 2-bath house on a corner lot with a large fenced back garden full of fruit trees, a living room with high vaulted ceilings and crown molding, tile floors and a kitchen refreshed with quartz worktops. Hurricane impact windows, A/C from 2018 and a Ring camera. The garage is now an extra room with the washer and dryer and can go back to a garage. Community pool, tennis, basketball and lakeside paths, with a low HOA. Asking US$490,000 (about €439,000), 1,103 sq ft (102 m²).

homes.title: Renovated 0-bed condo in Little River, South Carolina
homes.title_es: Condo renovado de 0 dormitorios en Little River, Carolina del Sur
homes.summary: 63 m² (680 sq ft), 1 bath, built 1988. Asking $97,500. The listing mentions: stackable washer dryer, large kitchen pantry, large storage room, community pool. HOA about $329 a month.

homes.title: Renovated 2-bed house in Beeville, Texas
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios reformada en Beeville, Texas
homes.summary: 74 m² (798 sq ft), 2 bed, 1 bath, built 1965. Asking $109,000. The listing mentions: new cha system, new plumbing, new electrical, new meter loop.

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bed house in Marion, Indiana
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir en Marion, Indiana
homes.summary: 71 m² (768 sq ft), 2 bed, 1 bath, built 1954. Asking $129,900. The listing mentions: private fenced-in backyard, detached garage, newer gas furnace, newer central air.

homes.title: Two-bedroom with a screened balcony over the fairways at Coronado Tower II
homes.title_es: Apartamento de dos dormitorios con balcón con mosquitero sobre el campo de golf en Coronado Tower II
homes.summary: A 1,313 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath flat at Coronado Tower II with a screened balcony over the golf course and the skyline, wide sliding doors into the living and dining room, tile floors, a white kitchen and a walk-in closet. Gated building with a pool, gym and 24-hour security. Asking US$299,000 (about €267,900), 1,313 sq ft (122 m²).

homes.title: Move-in ready 2-bed house in Marion, Indiana
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir en Marion, Indiana
homes.summary: 78 m² (840 sq ft), 2 bed, 1 bath, built 1946. Asking $109,900. The listing mentions: oversized lot, renovated kitchen, updated bathroom, large storage shed.

homes.title: Townhouse with vaulted wood ceilings and two primary suites in Plantation
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con techos abovedados de madera y dos suites principales en Plantation
homes.summary: A 2-bed, 2-bath townhouse of 1,030 sq ft with two primary suites and remodeled bathrooms, an upgraded kitchen, vaulted wood ceilings, a skylight, a stone accent wall and a loft. In the heart of Plantation, minutes from Plantation Walk, with quick access to the Turnpike, I-595 and Fort Lauderdale airport. Asking US$297,500.
